test_title: PYST 23: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 19th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Convert the sentence from passive to active voice:

The proposal was rejected by the board.

options.text: The rejection was by the board.
The board had rejected the proposal.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Passive Voice:** The proposal was rejected by the board.
 
• **Active Voice:** To convert a sentence from passive to active voice, identify the subject performing the action and place it at the beginning of the sentence, followed by the verb and the object.
 
• **Conversion:**
 
 
• The subject performing the action (board) becomes the subject of the sentence.
 
• The verb (was rejected) changes to its active form (rejected).
 
• The object (the proposal) follows the verb.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The board rejected the proposal."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** “The rejection was by the board.”

 
 
• This option rephrases the sentence in passive voice without effectively converting it to active voice.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** “The board had rejected the proposal.”
 
 
• While this option uses active voice, it changes the tense to past perfect, which does not match the tense of the original sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** “The proposal rejected the board.”
 
 
• This option incorrectly reverses the subject and object, leading to a nonsensical sentence.
